name: com.hawkes.analytics
description: Hawkes Analytics for Unity WebGL games (Hawkes Gen's player analytics, docs/analytics.md): HawkesAnalytics.Track/Screen/SetContext/LevelStart/LevelEnd/Death/Feedback/Ask… call window.hawkesAnalytics in the page, and load the SDK there when the page hasn't (product id from Resources/HawkesAnalyticsSettings). In the Editor and outside WebGL it only logs. Runtime package; nothing else is needed in the game's website.
